content: AutosarParameterRef With the advent of AutosarParam- eterRef , it is possible to implement a uniform reference to a ParameterDataPro- totype that covers all foreseen use cases: • Reference to a localParameter , no AtpInstanceRef required. • Reference to an autosarParameter (which involves an AtpInstanceRef ).
